name: Nightingale's Hoard
purpose: The user's own data workbench: ingest files/folders/URLs into a local DuckDB workbench, clean data with versioned steps (undo/redo, lineage, replay), run quality rules, build charts and dashboards, and train quick models — every operation recorded and explained. Includes independent exact arithmetic, symbolic math, units, dates, statistics and SQL-over-files calculation modules, all OFF by default.
notes: Start explicitly from Hoard Hub. Data and Calculation default OFF. MCP discovery reads the static catalog without starting the server or engines. Full native tools and data remain available after explicit activation.

requires.es: Indica de dónde salen los datos: la herramienta del Hub, la app o la carpeta, y el periodo.
requires.en: Name where the data comes from: the hub tool, the app or the folder, and the period.

requires.es: Enuncia las preguntas que deben responder las cifras, con su unidad.
requires.en: State the questions the figures must answer, with their unit.

check.en: Run data_quality on the dataset, then hand the chart or table over with data_handoff and compare its version and fingerprint with data_list and data_log.
check.es: Ejecuta data_quality sobre el conjunto de datos, pasa el gráfico o la tabla con data_handoff y coteja su versión y su huella con data_list y data_log.
